testsuite.name: com.systemwebstudio.isolation.IsolationApiTests

testcase.name: without a session every project route is 401()
a project viewer reads the basics, cannot read form data and cannot write anything()
an outsider learns nothing and changes nothing through any combination of foreign workspace and project ids()
audit events are scoped to the caller's workspace even when a foreign project id is passed as a filter()
an archived project is read-only for its owner too()
a workspace member without a role on the project cannot see it or act on it()
a role in one workspace grants nothing in another()
workspace-level routes of a foreign workspace are hidden and create nothing()
a disabled account loses every route on its next request, reads and writes alike()
ids of another project's versions, assets, domains and deployments are not usable through my own project()
